decisions.reason: The required About-page copy change is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including six tickets and commission allocated by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners.
The referral-free ticket and commission allocation rule does not change NFT cover rendering, wallet media rendering, or the candidate's contract scope.
The source changes reward creation and recipient selection, but it does not change which metadata fields are visible or the candidate's metadata contract scope.
Allocating referral-free tickets and commission by weighted draw does not alter how book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets behave when an NFT is transferred.
The source does not change which mints are finalized or which NFTs are counted as owned; it changes rewards generated by a referral-free purchase.
The weighted allocation of referral-free rewards does not affect whether an owner can locate an NFT in a wallet or dashboard.

The source does not change the candidate's prize-pool or platform-statistics contract scope or fresh-draw state; the observed ticket count concerns reward allocation rather than those stored attributes.
The source establishes how referral-free rewards are created and allocated, but it does not independently modify the candidate's reporting scope or legacy-data inclusion rules.
